item.title: Overview of Matthew Part 1 - Recognizing the King (Matthew 1-16) 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine arriving in a country that has spent centuries waiting for a king. The stories are everywhere. Elderly parents tell them to their children. Teachers repeat them from ancient writings. Worshipers sing about them in their prayers. Long ago, God promised that one day He would send a ruler who would set everything right. He would defeat evil, rescue God’s people, and bring God’s blessing to the nations. But the years pass. Then the decades. Then the centuries. Empires rise and fall. Wars are fought. Generations are born and die. Some people still believe the promises. Others quietly wonder whether God has forgotten them.

item.title: Overview of Daniel - Exile, Empire, and the Everlasting Kingdom
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # There are seasons in life when a person suddenly realizes that the world around them is larger, more demanding, and more morally complex than they ever imagined. Picture a young woman named Mara, newly accepted into a prestigious international internship. She arrives in a foreign city whose skyline glitters with ambition and whose streets pulse with a culture that is not her own. On her first day, she is ushered into a towering glass building where executives stride through the halls with the confidence of people who believe they shape the future. The company is powerful, admired, and feared. Its influence reaches far beyond its walls, shaping markets, policies, and even the behavior of its employees.
